purpose: Teach: 素質/各界/度胸/議事堂/飽和/イニシアチブ/肝要/切り取っ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究者としての素質を磨け
lines.en: Ren — develop your instincts as a researcher.
lines.style: Calm, measured authority. Low pitch, no hurry. Weight behind each phrase. The tone of someone who has seen many researchers and knows what separates good from great.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。各界の専門家と交流しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm actively engaging with experts across different fields.
lines.style: Respectful but grounded. Clear diction, slight formality in bearing. A young man demonstrating he's already acting on implicit expectations, not just listening.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会発表は度胸が大事だ
lines.en: Ren — at conferences, confidence is everything.
lines.style: Slightly firmer than before. A tap of emphasis on the core point. Leaning in slightly, eyes steady. This is not abstract theory—it's a test of character.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。議事堂での公聴会にも参加します
lines.en: Yes. I'm also attending public hearings at the Diet.
lines.style: Quick, assured response. Demonstrates he understands the step up in stakes. Respectful but not hesitant. The confidence of someone who has already moved beyond the classroom.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文の飽和市場でも独自性を出せ
lines.en: Ren — even in a saturated field, find what makes your work distinct.
lines.style: Slower tempo. A philosophical note underneath the directive. Not lecturing—sharing a hard-won truth. Eyes searching, as if asking: do you understand what you're up against?

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究分野でイニシアチブを取ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll take the initiative in my research area.
lines.style: Direct, almost clipped. No uncertainty. A young academic showing he's parsed the challenge and accepted it without needing to be convinced.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究では肝要な仮説に集中しろ
lines.en: Ren — concentrate on the essential hypotheses in your work.
lines.style: Final instruction, quieter intensity. The pace slows. This is the core wisdom—focus, not breadth. Almost fatherly, but still entirely professional.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の重要部分を切り取って要旨にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll distill the key elements into a clear summary.
lines.style: Calm close. He has listened. No bravado, no apology. A brief, grounded confirmation that the message has landed and will be acted upon.
